announcements.title: Recent Updates
items: Course tables have a new `Selected` checkbox. Tick a course if you plan to take it. You can choose the study period later in Planner.
Planner has a new `Selected Courses` tab. You can choose study periods for all ticked courses there.
Your 2nd Major is saved after login. You do not need to choose it again.
If you untick `Selected`, its `Study Period` is cleared as well.
